title: Reading Practice Test 01 – Office Operations
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: đoạn đơn, câu hỏi từ vựng, chèn câu, đoạn kép). Chủ đề: vận hành văn phòng.

questions.content: Employees are reminded to turn off ------- computers before leaving the office on Friday.
questions.explanation: Trước danh từ 'computers' cần tính từ sở hữu → 'their'. 'theirs' là đại từ sở hữu, đứng một mình.

questions.content: The new filing system has made it much ------- to locate client records.
questions.explanation: 'much' đứng trước để nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn → 'easier'. Cấu trúc make it + adj + to V.

questions.content: Ms. Alvarez will be out of the office ------- next Wednesday, so please contact her assistant with urgent matters.
questions.explanation: Trạng thái kéo dài (vắng mặt) tới một mốc → 'until'. 'by' dùng cho hạn chót của hành động xảy ra một lần.

questions.content: All requests for office supplies must be ------- by a department manager.
questions.explanation: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: must be + V3, có 'by a department manager' → 'approved'.

questions.content: The maintenance team ------- the air-conditioning units on the third floor last weekend.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'last weekend' → thì quá khứ đơn 'inspected'.

questions.content: ------- the printer on the second floor is being repaired, employees may use the one in the lobby.
questions.explanation: Cần liên từ nối hai mệnh đề với nghĩa 'trong khi' → 'While'. 'Despite' + danh từ; 'Therefore' là trạng từ nối; 'Unless' sai nghĩa.

questions.content: The office manager asked everyone to keep the kitchen area clean and -------.
questions.explanation: keep + O + tính từ; song song với tính từ 'clean' → 'organized' (ngăn nắp).

questions.content: Please submit your vacation requests at least two weeks in -------.
questions.explanation: Cụm cố định 'in advance' = trước, sớm. 'ahead' đi với 'ahead of time', không dùng 'in ahead'.

questions.content: The company has decided to ------- its paper usage by switching to digital invoices.
questions.explanation: reduce usage = giảm lượng sử dụng. refuse (từ chối), remove (gỡ bỏ), retire (nghỉ hưu) không hợp nghĩa.

questions.content: Only employees ------- have completed the safety training may operate the paper shredder.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ cho 'have completed' → 'who'. 'whom' làm tân ngữ; 'which' chỉ vật.

groups.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Karen Wells, Office Manager
Date: March 3
Subject: New Printing Procedures

Starting Monday, March 10, all printers in the building will require employees to scan their ID badges before documents are printed. This new system ---131--- us track printing costs by department.

In addition, all printers will print on both sides of the page by default. ---132---. If you need to print single-sided documents, you can change this setting in the print menu.

We expect these changes to reduce paper waste ---133--- thirty percent. Instructions for using the badge scanners ---134--- next to each printer.

Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.explanation: Hệ thống bắt đầu từ thứ Hai 10/3 (tương lai) → 'will help'.

options.A: This will save both paper and money.
options.B: The printers were purchased last year.
options.C: Please return your badge to the security desk.
options.D: Our office will be closed on Monday.

questions.explanation: Câu trước nói in hai mặt mặc định → câu phù hợp nêu lợi ích: tiết kiệm giấy và tiền. Các câu khác lạc ý.
reduce/increase + by + mức thay đổi: giảm (đi) 30% → 'by'.
Chủ ngữ 'Instructions' là vật, chịu tác động (được dán) và việc xảy ra trong tương lai → bị động 'will be posted'.

groups.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS
Harbor Point Business Center

The freight elevator will be out of service on Saturday, May 18, from 8:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. while technicians replace its cables. Tenants expecting deliveries on that day should ask couriers to use the loading dock entrance on Wells Street, where a member of the building staff will be available to assist.

The passenger elevators will operate as usual. Questions may be directed to the management office at extension 110.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the notice?

options.A: To announce a temporary service interruption

questions.explanation: Thang máy chở hàng ngừng hoạt động trong một ngày để thay cáp → thông báo gián đoạn dịch vụ tạm thời.

questions.content: What are tenants advised to do?

options.A: Use the stairs instead of the elevators
options.B: Have deliveries brought to a different entrance

questions.explanation: '…should ask couriers to use the loading dock entrance on Wells Street.' (A) sai vì thang máy chở khách vẫn chạy bình thường.

groups.passage:
To: Office staff
From: Daniel Reyes
Date: June 2
Subject: Kitchen renovation

Hi everyone,

As many of you know, the second-floor kitchen will be renovated from June 9 to June 20. During this period, the refrigerator and microwave will be moved to Conference Room C, which will serve as a temporary break room. Please note that the conference room will therefore not be available for meetings.

When the work is complete, the kitchen will have a larger dining area, a new dishwasher, and a coffee machine that makes espresso drinks. The coffee machine was chosen based on the results of last month's staff survey.

If you have any food stored in the kitchen refrigerator, please remove it by Friday, June 6. Anything left after that date will be thrown away.

Thanks,
Daniel Reyes
Facilities Coordinator

questions.content: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?

options.A: To request suggestions for a new kitchen
options.B: To announce changes during a construction project

questions.explanation: E-mail báo việc sửa nhà bếp và các thay đổi trong thời gian thi công (chuyển tủ lạnh, lò vi sóng sang phòng họp C).

questions.content: What is suggested about Conference Room C?

options.B: It is located on the third floor.
options.C: It will get a new coffee machine.
options.D: It cannot be reserved for meetings for a while.

questions.explanation: 'The conference room will therefore not be available for meetings' – phòng tạm làm phòng nghỉ nên không đặt họp được.

questions.content: According to the e-mail, why was the coffee machine selected?

options.A: It was the least expensive model.
options.C: Staff expressed a preference for it.
options.D: It was used in another office.

questions.explanation: 'The coffee machine was chosen based on the results of last month's staff survey' → dựa trên ý kiến nhân viên.

groups.passage:
Local Firm Wins Workplace Design Award

SPRINGFIELD (April 12) – Carver & Lane, an accounting firm with offices on Main Street, has received this year's Best Workplace Award from the Springfield Business Council. [1] The award recognizes companies that create comfortable and productive work environments for their employees.

Last year, Carver & Lane redesigned its offices after surveying its sixty employees. [2] The firm replaced rows of cubicles with open work areas, added several quiet rooms for focused work, and installed desks that can be raised for standing. "Our staff told us they wanted more natural light and more places to concentrate," said managing partner Ruth Carver. [3]

The changes appear to be working. According to the firm, employee absences fell by eighteen percent in the first six months after the redesign. [4] The award will be presented at the council's annual dinner on May 2.

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.A: The opening of a new accounting firm
options.B: A new city regulation for offices
options.C: A company's recognition for its workplace
options.D: The results of a council survey

questions.explanation: Bài báo nói về việc Carver & Lane nhận giải Nơi làm việc tốt nhất nhờ thiết kế văn phòng.

questions.content: What did Carver & Lane do before redesigning its offices?

options.A: It asked its employees for their opinions.
options.B: It moved to a new building.

questions.explanation: '…redesigned its offices after surveying its sixty employees' → hỏi ý kiến nhân viên trước.

questions.content: The word "appear" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'The changes appear to be working' = có vẻ đang hiệu quả → appear = seem. 'arrive/show up' là nghĩa 'xuất hiện' – không hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Many employees had complained that the previous layout was noisy and crowded."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn giải thích vì sao công ty khảo sát rồi thiết kế lại; đặt ở [2] – sau câu về khảo sát và trước câu mô tả thay đổi (bỏ vách ngăn, thêm phòng yên tĩnh).

groups.passage:
SPARKLE OFFICE CLEANING
Serving the downtown business district since 2012

Choose the plan that fits your office:
• Basic – $300/month: Weekly cleaning of floors, desks, and restrooms
• Standard – $550/month: Cleaning twice a week, plus kitchen and window cleaning
• Premium – $900/month: Daily cleaning, plus carpet shampooing every three months
• Custom – Price on request: Tell us what you need!

New customers who sign a one-year contract receive their first month free. All of our staff members are trained in using eco-friendly cleaning products.
Call 555-0147 or visit sparkleclean.com for a free estimate.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: info@sparkleclean.com
From: m.obi@lindenlegal.com
Date: September 8
Subject: Cleaning service

Hello,

I am the office manager at Linden Legal Services, a law firm with twenty employees. Our current cleaning company is closing at the end of this month, so we are looking for a new provider.

We would like our offices cleaned twice a week, and it is important that the kitchen is included, since our staff use it heavily. We do not need window cleaning, however, because our building management already provides it. I am hoping this might lower the monthly cost.

We are prepared to sign a one-year contract. Could someone visit our office next week to provide an estimate? I am available any afternoon except Thursday.

Best regards,
Martha Obi

questions.content: What is indicated about Sparkle Office Cleaning?

options.B: It has been in business for over twenty years.
options.D: It includes window cleaning in every plan.

questions.explanation: Quảng cáo: 'All of our staff members are trained in using eco-friendly cleaning products.' (B) sai – hoạt động từ 2012.

questions.content: Why is Ms. Obi looking for a new cleaning service?

options.A: Her firm is moving to a new building.
options.B: She is dissatisfied with the current service.
options.C: The current provider will stop operating.
options.D: Her company has hired more staff.

questions.explanation: E-mail: 'Our current cleaning company is closing at the end of this month.'

questions.content: Which plan offers the cleaning frequency that Ms. Obi requests?
questions.explanation: Cô muốn dọn hai lần mỗi tuần kèm nhà bếp → gói Standard ('Cleaning twice a week, plus kitchen…'). Câu hỏi kết hợp hai đoạn.

questions.content: What does Ms. Obi hope will happen?

options.A: The cleaning will start this week.
options.B: Her building manager will pay for the service.
options.C: Sparkle will clean the windows for free.
options.D: The price will be lower because one service is not needed.

questions.explanation: 'We do not need window cleaning… I am hoping this might lower the monthly cost.'

questions.content: What will Ms. Obi's firm most likely receive if it becomes a customer?
questions.explanation: Cô sẵn sàng ký hợp đồng một năm (e-mail); quảng cáo: khách mới ký hợp đồng một năm được miễn phí tháng đầu → kết hợp hai đoạn.
